column1: # Per-symbol allowlist for algeon-cudf's `#[doc(hidden)] pub` surface.
# `cargo public-api` omits hidden items, so scripts/ci/check_public_api_hidden.py
# checks this ledger against the source instead of a snapshot. Module rows cover
# unattributed children inside that module. Every attributed hidden symbol has
# its own row: methods as `Type::method`, trait impl methods as
# `<Type as Trait>::method`, fields as `Type.field`, and `pub use` leaves by the
# name they introduce. `feature` is derived from the item's cfg; `cross-crate`
# means it needs none of the seam features. `consumer` lists the workspace crates
# that reach the item from outside this crate's src: `prod` is library or server
# code, `tools` is bench, tools, examples, and workloads code, `tests` is
# integration tests and cfg(test) code. The item counts as used when a path names
# it or a value of its type crosses the crate boundary.
